up: Retrieve the distinct ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested against the target with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL262' (human glycogen synthase kinase-3 beta). Filter assays by this target identifier in the target dictionary. Return exactly two columns: the compound ChEMBL ID and the canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays a ON td.tid = a.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL262'
